title: Towards Generalizable Reasoning: Group Causal Counterfactual Policy Optimization for LLM Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2602.06475v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) excel at complex tasks with advances in reasoning capabilities. However, existing reward mechanisms remain tightly coupled to final correctness and pay little attention to the underlying reasoning process: trajectories with sound reasoning but wrong answers receive low credit, while lucky guesses with flawed logic may be highly rewarded, affecting reasoning generalization. From a causal perspective, we interpret multi-candidate reasoning for a fixed question as a family of counterfactual experiments. translated_title: 迈向可泛化推理：用于大语言模型推理的群体因果反事实策略优化
translated_abstract: 随着推理能力的进步，大语言模型（LLM）在复杂任务中表现出色。然而，现有的奖励机制仍然与最终答案的正确性紧密耦合，很少关注底层的推理过程：推理合理但答案错误的轨迹只能获得较低的奖励，而逻辑有缺陷却侥幸猜对的答案却可能获得高奖励，这影响了推理的泛化能力。从因果视角出发，我们将针对固定问题的多候选推理解释为一族反事实实验。在此基础上，我们提出了群体因果反事实策略优化，以显式训练大语言模型学习可泛化的推理模式。该方法提出了一种情景化的因果反事实奖励，共同捕捉：(i) 稳健性，即鼓励由推理步骤所诱导的答案分布在反事实扰动下保持稳定；(ii) 有效性，即强制足够的变化性，以便……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文从因果视角将多候选推理视为一族反事实实验，提出群体因果反事实策略优化，通过同时评估推理稳健性与有效性的反事实奖励机制，训练大语言模型超越仅以答案正确性为标准的学习方式，从而掌握可泛化的推理模式。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Group Causal Counterfactual Policy Optimization, which interprets multi-candidate reasoning as a family of counterfactual experiments and introduces an episodic causal counterfactual reward capturing both robustness and effectiveness to train LLMs toward generalizable reasoning patterns beyond mere answer correctness.
